editorial:
Imagine moving to a boring new town where you have zero friends and everything feels gray. That is exactly where you find Itsy, a girl who just wants to make a name for herself as a journalist. She meets her neighbor Calvin, a quirky kid who is convinced aliens kidnapped his parents. At first, you will think Itsy is just using him for a big story, but the movie quickly turns into a sweet story about loneliness and friendship. It has a very cozy, indie feel that makes you root for these two outsiders as they try to figure out the mystery together.

You will love how the young actors bring so much heart to their roles, making the emotional moments feel real. While the plot moves a bit slow in the middle, the payoff is totally worth it. It is the perfect pick for a lazy Sunday afternoon with the family. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the cool space details, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you love collecting movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this gem forever.
endingExplained: After spending the whole movie doubting Calvin, Itsy finally discovers that he was right all along. The aliens actually return, and it turns out they were not evil, just confused. Calvin is reunited with his parents in a heartwarming scene that proves believing in the impossible can pay off. Itsy realizes that friendship is more important than a news story, and the movie ends with the kids bonding over their shared secret.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves coming-of-age stories with a weird twist.
